resources.string: To measure next-word suggestions, commit short parts of the target (for example: tomorrow → together → eat). Only this active test field is measured; practice does not train predictions. Once the full target is committed, the intended next word is unknown.

Prediction usage is separate from raw pinyin accuracy. Estimated savings count prescribed pinyin letter keys, not measured total taps. Latency ends after complete visible candidate text is drawn; it is not hardware screen presentation time.
